dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, irregular dark perimeters that softly gradient into lighter grey centers. Three primary rings in the central-dorsal region show well-defined, thin boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid low-intensity pixel clusters localized in the spaces between larger annuli, particularly in the mid-to-lower lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a large scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of four smaller blobs in the posterior region forms an irregular quadrilateral.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of approximately 5-6 parallel, vertical linear scars or marks are visible on the lateral-ventral neck area, forming a rake-like geometric pattern.
